channel.title: TapTill: Blog
channel.description: UK card payment news for business owners: contactless limits, surcharge rules, provider takeovers, fees and contracts, checked against official sources.

item.title: The £100 contactless limit has gone: what it means for your business
item.description: The FCA removed the fixed £100 contactless limit in March 2026. What changed, why some cards still stop at £100 and what it means for your card machines.

item.title: Global Payments now owns Worldpay: what it means for UK merchants
item.description: Global Payments completed its Worldpay takeover in January 2026, adding it to takepayments. What it means for UK merchants’ contracts, terminals and switching.

item.title: Can you charge customers for paying by card?
item.description: UK card surcharge rules for businesses: the 2018 ban on consumer card surcharges, what’s allowed for business cards, minimum spends and cash discounts.

item.title: Pay as you go or subscription: when does a monthly plan pay off?
item.description: A worked example comparing a 1.69% pay-as-you-go card rate with a £19-a-month plan at 0.99%: the break-even point and what to check before you switch.

item.title: How to read a card machine quote
item.description: Large UK card acquirers must give small businesses a summary box of prices and renewal reminders. How to read a quote and compare providers like for like.
